fixed.climate: none of its own: an enclosed, crowded courtroom on a summer evening (geography.json LOC-courtroom 'close and crowded')

dream_design.flora: garlands of red and white roses (the garden's roses brought indoors) wound round the throne canopy and the jury-box rail; potted lilies at the dais
dream_design.ornament_cues: the tall west windows are the scene's stained-glass accent: leaded rose-and-heart roundels in their upper lights, so the evening shafts cross the dust in soft coloured tints; a circular halo roundel behind the throne; whiplash vine tracery along the gallery front and the herald's stand (form and material belong to architecture)
dream_design.palette: pastel-and-gold warmed by the golden hour: ivory and old gold woodwork, rose-pink and pale amber glass tints, card red as the only saturated accent; the gold deepens across S01 to S08 with the waking sun
dream_design.reason: The court, crowd and summer-day tarts are explicit (ch011-p01, p12). Stained glass, garlands and palette are designed to WR-010. Only the tint of the window shafts matters to the states; lighting decides the actual values.

fixed.exterior_state: outside the windows: clear summer evening, golden hour, sun low in the west-north-west, matching SCN-riverbank S02 at the waking
fixed.atmosphere: warm, stuffy, crowded air; dust motes hanging in the low evening sun through tall west windows
fixed.dream_growth: Grows from a court of justice Alice has only read about in books (cp-court). The courtroom holds the last of the real evening: low golden sun raking through high windows as it now rakes under the trees onto the sleeping Alice. At the climax the pack of cards rising and flying at her is the light breeze on the bank bringing a few dry leaves down onto her face (cp-cards-leaves, SUP-004). A draught through the windows starts the flight and match-cuts to the waking.

source.quote: The King and Queen of Hearts were seated on their throne when they arrived, with a great crowd assembled about them

also_seen.quote: The Queen of Hearts, she made some tarts, All on a summer day
the whole pack rose up into the air, and came flying down upon her

fixed.reason: The crowd and the summer-day accusation are explicit (ch011-p01, ch011-p12). Windows, evening light, dust and the draught are designed so the flying pack can grow from the waking breeze and leaves (ch012-p64, world.json cp-cards-leaves) per ruling 5.2 A.

states.diegetic_daylight: low golden sun (outside elevation about 10 deg, west-north-west) slanting through tall west windows in long shafts across the crowd and the tarts on the centre table
